mapper.select: SELECT a.*, e.name AS employeeName, e.employee_no AS empNo FROM employee_mobile_change_application a LEFT JOIN employee e ON e.id = a.employee_id WHERE a.id = #{id}

SELECT a.*, e.name AS employeeName, e.employee_no AS empNo FROM employee_mobile_change_application a LEFT JOIN employee e ON e.id = a.employee_id WHERE a.employee_id = #{employeeId} ORDER BY a.created_at DESC
SELECT a.*, e.name AS employeeName, e.employee_no AS empNo FROM employee_mobile_change_application a LEFT JOIN employee e ON e.id = a.employee_id WHERE a.status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY a.created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO employee_mobile_change_application (instance_id, employee_id, user_id, old_mobile, new_mobile, sms_verified, reason, status) VALUES (#{instanceId}, #{employeeId}, #{userId}, #{oldMobile}, #{newMobile}, #{smsVerified}, #{reason}, #{status})
